_why: build-doc §11 — 'fixtures/mini-node.json (3 species, tiny counts — hand-checkable sim math)'. Real species from bible §4 (G2: nothing invented), one per trophic level of the Meadow: loamunder-line is the Producer, nibbin-line the Grazer, skir-line the Mesopredator. The counts and breed rates are chosen so that ONE full ecosim.step() lands on exact integers with no stochastic rounding at all — the arithmetic is checkable on paper, and the step consumes zero RNG draws. tests/property/ecosim.test.ts carries the hand computation term by term.

_handComputedStep.loamunder-line: Producer → no live diet → foodFactor = noDietFoodFactor 1.0; births 10 × 0.12 × 1.0 = 1.2; predation from nibbin 2.0 × (10/100) = 0.2; 10 + 1.2 − 0.2 = 11.0
_handComputedStep.nibbin-line: prey = loamunder 10 + flora 90 = 100; demand 20 × 3 = 60; ratio 1.667 → clamped to 1.25; births 20 × 0.04 × 1.25 = 1.0; predation from skir 1.0; 20 + 1.0 − 1.0 = 20.0
_handComputedStep.skir-line: prey = nibbin 20; demand 10 × 2 = 20; ratio 1.0; births 10 × 0.10 × 1.0 = 1.0; no predator; 10 + 1.0 = 11.0
